# metrics-server (env/prod/critical)

Wrapper chart that installs [metrics-server](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server)
into the `hivemind-prod` EKS cluster. It's what backs `kubectl top` and,
critically, what any `HorizontalPodAutoscaler` (e.g.
[`charts/env/prod/apps/greeter`](../../apps/greeter)'s, once
`autoscaling.enabled: true`) needs to read CPU/memory metrics — without it,
an HPA fails with `unable to fetch metrics from resource metrics API: the
server could not find the requested resource (get pods.metrics.k8s.io)`.

Lives under `charts/env/prod/critical/` for the same reason as
[`../karpenter`](../karpenter) and
[`../aws-load-balancer-controller`](../aws-load-balancer-controller):
cluster-scoped, one per cluster, pinned to the system node group.

No IAM/IRSA prerequisites — metrics-server only reads kubelet stats
in-cluster, no AWS API calls.

## Install

```bash
cd charts/env/prod/critical/metrics-server
helm dependency update

helm upgrade --install metrics-server . \
  --namespace kube-system \
  -f values.yaml
```

## Notes

* Managed by Argo CD via [`charts/env/prod/argocd-apps.yaml`](../../argocd-apps.yaml)
  (generated by [`scripts/generate-argocd-apps.sh`](../../../../../scripts/generate-argocd-apps.sh)) —
  no manual install needed once that's applied.
* `replicas: 2` for HA, unlike the chart's own default of 1 — this cluster
  already has ≥2 system nodes to spread across.
